items.name: TraceContextPropagator
items.summary: Propagates `SpanContext`s in [W3C TraceContext] format under `traceparent` and `tracestate` header.

methods.name: extract_with_context
methods.signature: fn extract_with_context(&self, cx: &Context, extractor: &dyn Extractor) -> Context
methods.summary: Retrieves encoded `SpanContext`s using the `Extractor`. It decodes the `SpanContext` and returns it. If no `SpanContext` was retrieved OR if the retrieved SpanContext is invalid then an empty `SpanContext` is returned.

methods.name: inject_context
methods.signature: fn inject_context(&self, cx: &Context, injector: &mut dyn Injector)
methods.summary: Properly encodes the values of the `SpanContext` and injects them into the `Injector`.
